sections.shortlist: Active proactive projects at a glance

templates.current:
Catalogue of **{total} projects / research code repositories and {papers} papers**. Metrics collected: **{as_of} (UTC)**; features manually verified: {reviewed}.

Based only on public documentation and GitHub metadata; no unified hands-on evaluation has been run. Categories and features require manual review, and metrics are refreshed by scripts.
templates.shortlist_note: Selected only from projects with a verified open license, a documented proactive mechanism and no archival flag, ordered by maintenance score; adjacent components, pending-license projects and historical projects do not enter this table.
templates.toc_note: `★Seed` marks reference projects provided by the user. Every category uses the same ordering rules, and archived projects are automatically pushed to the end. License display follows manual verification and GitHub SPDX identification; an unknown license is never treated as zero or defaulted to MIT.
templates.projects_note: Full descriptions, boundaries and evidence are in [project details](docs/projects.md). For separate star, activity and latest-commit views see the [ranking tables](docs/rankings.md).
templates.papers_note: Papers are grouped by research question; within a group, entries are sorted by first-submission date, newest first. Paper years, project stars and system capability are different kinds of assessment and are never mixed into one score.
templates.papers_link: Paper versions, code links and applicability boundaries are in [paper details](docs/papers.md).
templates.detail_intro: Every documented feature was verified against public documentation; nothing was installed, run, or put through a unified capability test. Evidence is pinned to the commit verified at review time, and later metric refreshes do not change feature judgements.
templates.entry:

templates.papers_intro: Titles and first-submission dates were verified against the original arXiv abstract pages (2026-11-05). Versions or renames of the same arXiv ID count as one paper. Conference status without independent verification is left as arXiv.
templates.paper_code_none: No code link verified in this round
templates.rankings_intro:
Ranking over full-catalogue metadata; components, research code and assistants only show maintenance metrics and are not interchangeable. Every view first tiers by maintenance status, then sorts by that view's metric in descending order; ties fall back to stars, then repository name, for a stable order.

Snapshot: {as_of}. The formula and field definitions are in [methodology.md](methodology.md).

```sh
python scripts/refresh_metrics.py   # requires a logged-in gh or GH_TOKEN
python scripts/build.py
python -m unittest discover -s tests
python scripts/build.py --check
```

GitHub Actions refreshes metrics and rankings for listed projects every day. New projects, papers and feature classifications merge only after manual verification; an automated metrics refresh does not mean features or licenses were re-audited.
templates.thanks:
Discovery entry points referenced [Awesome Proactive Agents](https://github.com/LowEntropyAI/awesome-proactive-agent) and [Awesome Personal Agents](https://github.com/upgundecha/awesome-personal-agents); every item was verified back at its original repository and paper.

Original explanations, curated data and maintenance scripts in this repository use the [MIT]({R}LICENSE) license. Linked projects, papers, models and data follow their own licenses.
templates.records_note: The [change records]({R}record/) preserve the original text (in Chinese) from the time of each verification, so the source and the wording behind every judgement stay auditable.
